Source code analysis confirms validateCollectionTTL() function exists and checks range [-1, 3155760000], but REST handler createCollection() in handler_v2.go doesn't transfer JSON 'properties' field to gRPC Properties array, bypassing validation. Raw evidence from REQ 2 & REQ 6 shows HTTP 200 success for invalid input. Current instance rejects same value, confirming the bug existed in 2.6.16 and was fixed.
